Package smart_food_delivery.domain

Class Order

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.domain.Order
Direct Known Subclasses:
ExpressOrder, ScheduledOrder, StandardOrder
public class Order extends Object
Represents a customer food order in the Smart Food Delivery Management System. Stores ordered items, delivery information, order status, assigned driver, pricing details, and payment status. This class is the parent class for StandardOrder, ExpressOrder, and ScheduledOrder.
